//@version=5
indicator("UCTPROBE_VW_FORIN_COLLECTIONS_2", overlay = false, max_lines_count = 100, max_boxes_count = 100, max_labels_count = 100)

// --- 2026-10-01 C48 - WHAT `vw-forin-collections` DID NOT SHOW ----------------------------
//
// That capture settled: `for x in <own list>` walks the LIVE list when the body shifts,
// pushes or sets (F03 / F04 / F05); `<family>.all` is a snapshot (A02 / A04 / A05) whose
// positions are oldest first (A06); `var ... = array.new_label(3)` holds three slots (Z).
// Served. Refused by name, until a row shows them:
//   G01  the body REMOVES the element it stands on    passes over 5 lines; which are left
//        (index walk over the live list -> 3 passes, y = 111 and 113 left)
//   G02  the body POPS                                passes over 5 (live -> 3)
//   G03  the body UNSHIFTS a line (4 at most)         passes over 3 (live -> 7); which line
//        a pass is handed after the front grew (x2 of each line = bar_index + 1 + pass)
//   G04  the body INSERTS at 0 (4 at most)            as G03
//   G05  the body CLEARS on its first pass            passes over 5 (live -> 1)
//   G06  the body REASSIGNS the list variable         passes; which list is walked
//   G07  a HELPER handed the list shifts it           passes over 5 (live -> 3)
//   S01  array.size(array.new_box(4, na))             4?
//   S02  a sized list declared WITHOUT `var`: labels on the chart after the
//        replace-in-place idiom on every bar          (one set per bar up to the cap? or 3?)
//   S03  an EMPTY drawing list declared WITHOUT `var`, pushed onto on every bar:
//        array.size after the push          (1 = made anew every bar; bar_index + 1 = kept)
//        and the lines on the chart with `if array.size(nv) > 1 -> line.delete(array.shift(nv))`
//        (made anew: none is ever deleted, the chart holds the last max_lines_count)
//   P01  positions in `label.all` once the collector has evicted: 60 labels made on the
//        last bar under max_labels_count = 100 with S02's on the chart
//
// CAPTURE: NYSE:RDDT 1D (from the listing), inputs at defaults (none), AFTER THE CLOSE.
// A runtime error is itself a reading - record its text and the bar it names.

f_shift(line[] a) =>
    if array.size(a) > 0
        line.delete(array.shift(a))

float G01 = na
float G02 = na
float G03 = na
float G04 = na
float G05 = na
float G06 = na
float G07 = na
float S01 = na
if barstate.islast
    line[] rm = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 4
        array.push(rm, line.new(bar_index, 110 + k, bar_index + 1, 110 + k))
    int p1 = 0
    for [i, l] in rm
        line.delete(array.remove(rm, i))
        p1 += 1
    G01 := p1
    line[] pp = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 4
        array.push(pp, line.new(bar_index, 120 + k, bar_index + 1, 120 + k))
    int p2 = 0
    for l in pp
        line.delete(array.pop(pp))
        p2 += 1
    G02 := p2
    line[] un = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 2
        array.push(un, line.new(bar_index, 130 + k, bar_index + 1, 130 + k))
    int p3 = 0
    for l in un
        line.set_x2(l, bar_index + 1 + p3)
        if p3 < 4
            array.unshift(un, line.new(bar_index, 135 + p3, bar_index + 1, 135 + p3))
        p3 += 1
    G03 := p3
    line[] ins = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 2
        array.push(ins, line.new(bar_index, 140 + k, bar_index + 1, 140 + k))
    int p4 = 0
    for l in ins
        line.set_x2(l, bar_index + 1 + p4)
        if p4 < 4
            array.insert(ins, 0, line.new(bar_index, 145 + p4, bar_index + 1, 145 + p4))
        p4 += 1
    G04 := p4
    line[] cl = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 4
        array.push(cl, line.new(bar_index, 150 + k, bar_index + 1, 150 + k))
    int p5 = 0
    for l in cl
        array.clear(cl)
        p5 += 1
    G05 := p5
    line[] ra = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 4
        array.push(ra, line.new(bar_index, 160 + k, bar_index + 1, 160 + k))
    line[] rb = array.new_line()
    array.push(rb, line.new(bar_index, 169, bar_index + 1, 169))
    int p6 = 0
    for l in ra
        line.set_x2(l, bar_index + 3)
        ra := rb
        p6 += 1
    G06 := p6
    line[] hs = array.new_line()
    for k = 0 to 4
        array.push(hs, line.new(bar_index, 170 + k, bar_index + 1, 170 + k))
    int p7 = 0
    for l in hs
        f_shift(hs)
        p7 += 1
    G07 := p7
    S01 := array.size(array.new_box(4, na))

label[] zn = array.new_label(3)
for i = 0 to 2
    label.delete(array.get(zn, i))
    array.set(zn, i, label.new(bar_index, 190 + i, "N" + str.tostring(i)))
int s2 = 0
for l in label.all
    if label.get_y(l) >= 190 and label.get_y(l) < 200
        s2 += 1
float S02 = s2

line[] nv = array.new_line()
array.push(nv, line.new(bar_index, 300, bar_index + 1, 300))
float S03 = array.size(nv)
if array.size(nv) > 1
    line.delete(array.shift(nv))
int s4 = 0
for l in line.all
    if line.get_y1(l) == 300
        s4 += 1
float S04 = s4

if barstate.islast
    for k = 0 to 59
        label.new(bar_index, 200 + k, "P")
    for [i, l] in label.all
        label.set_text(l, str.tostring(i) + "|" + str.tostring(label.get_y(l)))

plot(G01, "G01_forin_passes_body_removes")
plot(G02, "G02_forin_passes_body_pops")
plot(G03, "G03_forin_passes_body_unshifts")
plot(G04, "G04_forin_passes_body_inserts")
plot(G05, "G05_forin_passes_body_clears")
plot(G06, "G06_forin_passes_body_reassigns")
plot(G07, "G07_forin_passes_helper_shifts")
plot(S01, "S01_sized_with_na_size")
plot(S02, "S02_nonvar_sized_labels_held")
plot(S03, "S03_nonvar_list_size_after_push")
plot(S04, "S04_nonvar_list_lines_on_chart")
plot(bar_index, "C00_bar_index_CONTROL")
